success_criteria.B_calibration: PASS if Brier skill vs frozen climatology >= -0.005 (the probability is at least as good as knowing the base rate)
success_criteria.C_confident_ml: Primary = rolling rule. CONFIRMED if hit rate > 50% AND Pesaran-Timmermann p < 0.05 on non-overlapping calls; REJECTED if hit rate <= 50%; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE. C_fixed is reported with the same criteria as a secondary result.
success_criteria.D_improved_playbook: BETTER if profit factor > engine-playbook profit factor AND mean $/trade > engine mean $/trade; PROFITABLE only if additionally mean $/trade > 0 with one-sided t-test p < 0.05
success_criteria.A_engine: Reference only (expected ~50% hit rate based on the backtest)

amendment_before_start: The lockbox experiment used a fixed confidence threshold (0.1402). The final model trained on all data is less confident (its 70th-percentile confidence is ~0.065 live vs 0.140 in DEV), so the fixed threshold would call ~5% of hours. The primary rule was therefore changed, before any forward data was logged, to the top 30% relative to the model's own previous 500 hourly confidences. Walk-forward backtest of this rule: DEV 55.2% hit (PT p 0.008, coverage 23.6%), LOCKBOX 54.2% (PT p 0.34, coverage 29.4%). Because its lockbox result was seen while designing the fix, the forward test is its first clean evaluation.
